intervention.description: Only add achromatic edge or coarse wave in two of three existing texture slots. Original weak signal, amplitudes, frequencies and all other families are unchanged.

manifest.acceptance: Report all groups/seeds. An initial positive result requires both seeds to reduce reserved median absolute weak-gain error without increasing median MSE. This is not full validation.
limits: Prospective synthetic reserve for this single intervention, not a photographic or all-project holdout.
Frozen current Haar baseline already has 1024 updates; do not retrain or select it using reserve scores.
Same Gaussian seeds and noise laws; heteroscedastic noise amplitudes change when the clean signal changes.

reserve.role: Prospectively sealed heldout for this experiment only; not independent of all project design decisions or photographic validation.
reserve.policy: Open model predictions once after both candidates complete; no selection of weights or recipe from this reserve.
